subtitle: Keep the little flame alive
description:
Guide a paper lantern across a night lake.

Hold anywhere to rise, let go to drift down, and thread the gaps between hanging willows. Your flame is your fuel: rising burns it faster, and every firefly you catch tops it back up. Run out of light and your lantern sinks, so every hold is a small decision.

The lake speeds up and the gaps tighten the farther you go. Chase your best score one more run at a time.

One-thumb controls. Plays offline. No ads. No tracking. No in-app purchases.
promo: A cozy one-thumb flyer: rise, glide, and catch fireflies to keep your lantern lit.
reviewNote: Tap to start. Hold anywhere on the screen to rise, release to fall. Catch fireflies to refill the flame meter at the top right.
